product_metadata.title: As Seen on TV, Mad Hungry Spurtle 4pc Set, Acacia Premium Wood Finish, Cooking Utensils for Non Stick Cookware, Baking, Whisking, Smashing, Scooping, Spreading, Serving and More.
features: AS SEEN ON TV – With over 7 million sets sold, this best-selling As-Seen-On-TV acacia wood spurtle set features four spurtle designs to meet all your cooking needs, allowing you to stir, scoop, smash, scrape, serve, and more!

4 DESIGNS TO DO IT ALL – This 4-piece set includes an original spurtle (for stirring, scooping, smashing, scraping and serving), medium slotted spurtle (for sifting and draining), a skinny spurtle (for getting in tight, narrow jars and containers), and mini spurtle (for spreading).
SMART ERGONOMIC DESIGN – These spurtles get in every last nook and cranny of your pots and pans, as their special curved designs easily access edges and hard-to-reach areas.

ONE OF A KIND – No two spurtles are alike! Made of sustainable acacia wood, each piece is one of a kind, with every spurtle marked by nature’s unique thumbprint. Acacia wood is gentle on cookware and won’t scratch or damage your pots and pans.

CLASSIC ELEGANCE MEETS MODERN CONVENIENCE – Originating in 15th-century Europe, these hard-working cooking tools combine classic craftsmanship with modern technique for effortless cooking, baking and meal prep.
description: Declutter Your Kitchen Drawers: These Hard-Working Tools Do it All!

Say goodbye to crowded drawers overflowing with spoons, spatulas, whisks and cooking-utensils galore. Meet the greatest kitchen tools you never knew you were missing! Tried-and-true, and deeply rooted in tradition, these 15th-century European kitchen tools do just about everything, allowing you to stir, scoop, smash, scrape and serve with ease.

With special curved designs, these spurtles get in every last nook and cranny of your pots and pans, easily accessing edges and hard-to-reach areas. The Original As Seen on TV Mad Hungry 4-Piece Spurtle Set features four spurtle designs to meet all your cooking needs:
– Use the original spurtle to stir sauces, soups, oatmeals, and stews, or gently fold cake or souffle batter without deflating it. Easily crush tomatoes for sauce, or avocados for guacamole.
– The medium slotted spurtle is great for separating food from liquids, and sifting dry ingredients. Use it to whisk eggs, strain pasta, or sift flour.
– Effortlessly scour every last bit of jam, or pesto from your food processor with the handy skinny spurtle that fits into narrow jars and smaller containers.
– Use the mini spurtle to spread butter, peanut butter, mayo, and other spreads on sandwiches with ease and precision, or ice cupcakes to smooth perfection.

Made of sustainable acacia wood, each piece is one-of-a-kind, with every spurtle marked by nature’s unique thumbprint. The colorful spurtle handles are ergonomically designed for comfort and grip, while the gentle acacia wood will not scratch or damage your cookware. The spurtles’ attractive look makes them a great addition to your table, functioning also as elegant serving pieces. The spurtle handles come in your choice of natural, black, blue, and red.
